turns.user: What happens if I run out of storage?
turns.reply: Storage runs out -> Note deleted, warning shown until space freed. [END]

turns.user: Can I open Acme Notes on my tablet?
turns.reply: Yes, Acme Notes supports tablets. Open it via Google Play Store or App Store. [END]

turns.user: Can I use a different font for headings?
turns.reply: Yes, go to settings, find "Fonts," select preferred heading font. [END]

turns.user: How do I update the app?
turns.reply: Go to settings, find "Updates," check for updates, install them. [END]

turns.user: How do I archive an old notebook?
turns.reply: In settings, find "Notebooks," select old notebook, toggle "Archive" option. [END]
